items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: He dubbed it for Montgomery Clift.

ctx.x: It was a movie with Montomery Clift and Frank Sinatra. Do you remember that movie? The reason I mentioned it is because Manny Klein played the trumpet, the bugle on the sound track. He dubbed it for Montgomery Clift. Manny Klein played the taps beautifully.
